# `Object.prototype` members as C# `any-type` and `base-class` (see
# enum-option-prototype-csharp) on a top-level array of integers: no `any`
# is emitted, so `any-type` alone renders, but the top-level wrapper class
# still names the base class, which fails to serialize.
input schema Numbers {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}}
pipeline {"lang": "csharp"}

render csharp {"rendererOptions": {"any-type": "constructor"}}
render csharp {"rendererOptions": {"framework": "NewtonSoft", "any-type": "valueOf", "just-types": true}}
render csharp {"rendererOptions": {"base-class": "toString"}}
